subject: Re: Comment pitch: targeting climate finance where the exposure is
body:
Hi Megan,

Following up on my note from 31 August — a comment idea on how funders decide who is "most exposed", tied to your Pacific Resilience Facility and drought-deal coverage.

The offer stands: an evidence-based analysis of exposure counts (population, hospitals, schools, infrastructure) for climate-vulnerable regions, each figure source-labelled with uncertainty stated.

Happy to send a 250-word pitch or a short brief — or to close the loop if it is not a fit.

Best,
Motaz OMARIEN. Talaix
Earth Observation & Environmental Risk
Financial Decision Intelligence
Luxembourg-based technology team
info@talaix.com | talaix.com

subject: Re: Nepal's glacial flood — Earth-observation context on downstream exposure
body:
Hello,

A quick follow-up to my message of 31 August on the Nepal–Tibet flood. Talaix can still prepare satellite-based screening of the downstream area — terrain, flow paths, and what is exposed (settlements, hydropower, transport) — with source and resolution stated, not prediction.

If the story has moved on, glad to apply the same approach to your next extreme-weather piece — or to close the loop.
